headline: India Oil Refiners Face Pressure as Crude Basket Hits $123 Alongside Weak Rupee
summary: The Indian crude basket reached $123.29 per barrel, adding 86% to the procurement costs of domestic oil marketing companies. A depreciating rupee has further swollen dollar-denominated import bills.
why: India is the world's third-largest oil importer. Sharp increases in crude costs combined with currency weakness pressure corporate earnings, fiscal balances, and domestic inflation.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Surging oil import expenses and a weak rupee expand India's trade deficit and import costs.

impacts.name: Oil Refining
impacts.why: An 86% jump in crude acquisition costs strains operating cash flows for oil marketing firms.

why_moved: Crude prices touched $123.29 per barrel and compounded with a declining rupee, directly raising Indian fuel procurement costs.
